query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQC_LOSS_YIELD_SUM SELECT YEAR, MONTH, DAY, WEEK, TRAN_DAY, CUSTOMER, DEVICE_ALIAS, PRODUCT, TESTAREA, PROGRAM, TESTER, PROBE_CARD, STEP_ID, INSPECTION_EQ, SUM (TESTED_DIE) AS TESTED_DIE, SUM (DEFECTIVE_DIE) AS DEFECTIVE_DIE, SUM (BAD_DIE_CNT) AS BAD_DIE_CNT, ROUND(SUM (BAD_DIE_CNT) / SUM (DEFECTIVE_DIE) * 100, 2) AS KILL_RATIO, SUM (NETDIE) AS NETDIE, SUM (GOOD_CNT) AS GOOD_CNT, SUM (BAD_CNT) AS BAD_CNT, ROUND(SUM (BAD_CNT) / SUM (NETDIE) * 100, 2) AS LOSS_YIELD FROM TQC_MATCH_SUM WHERE 1 = 1 AND TEST_TRAN_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE ( TO_CHAR (SYSDATE - 1, 'YYYYMMDD') || '060000', 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') AND TO_DATE ( TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '055959', 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') GROUP BY YEAR, MONTH, DAY, WEEK, TRAN_DAY, CUSTOMER, DEVICE_ALIAS, PRODUCT, TESTAREA, PROGRAM, TESTER, PROBE_CARD, STEP_ID, INSPECTION_EQ

SELECT LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, PRODUCT, STEP_ID FROM TQC_MATCH_SUM WHERE 1 = 1 AND DEVICE_ALIAS = :device AND TESTAREA = :testarea AND TEST_TRAN_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sttime,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:endtime,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') GROUP BY LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, PRODUCT, STEP_ID

SELECT DEVICE_ALIAS, TESTAREA FROM TQC_MATCH_SUM WHERE 1 = 1 AND TEST_TRAN_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sttime,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:endtime,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') GROUP BY DEVICE_ALIAS, TESTAREA

SELECT LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, TESTAREA, DEVICE_ALIAS, PRODUCT, PROGRAM, CUSTOMER, DECODE (REGEXP_INSTR (SUBSTR (PRODUCT, 2, 2), '[^0-9]'), 0, ROUND (TO_NUMBER (SUBSTR (PRODUCT, 2, 2)) / 100, 2), 0) AS TECH, 0 AS PROSPECT_YIELD, 0 AS PROSPECT_INCLUDE_AVG_YIELD, ROUND (GOOD_CNT / TESTED_DIE * 100, 2) AS ACTUAL_YIELD, STEP_ID, ROUND (BAD_DIE_CNT / NETDIE * 100, 2) AS LOSS_YIELD FROM TQC_MATCH_SUM WHERE 1 = 1 AND DEVICE_ALIAS = :device AND TESTAREA = :teatarea AND TEST_TRAN_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sttime,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:endtime,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') ?? ORDER BY LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, TESTAREA, DEVICE_ALIAS, PRODUCT, PROGRAM, CUSTOMER

SELECT DEVICE_ALIAS, TESTAREA, STEP_ID, ROUND (SUM (BAD_DIE_CNT) / SUM (NETDIE) * 100, 2) AS LOSS_YIELD FROM TQC_LOSS_YIELD_SUM WHERE 1 = 1 AND DEVICE_ALIAS = :device AND TESTAREA = :teatarea AND TRAN_DAY BETWEEN TO_CHAR (SYSDATE - 30, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR (SYSDATE - 1, 'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY DEVICE_ALIAS, TESTAREA, STEP_ID ORDER BY DEVICE_ALIAS, TESTAREA, STEP_ID

INSERT INTO TQC_MATCH_SUM WITH WT AS ( SELECT TS.WAFER_SEQ, DM.STEP_SEQ, TS.END_TIME AS TEST_TRAN_TIME, TS.CUSTOMER, TS.DEVICE_ALIAS, TS.PRODUCT, TS.TESTAREA, TS.PROGRAM, TS.TESTER, TS.PROBE_CARD, DM.STEP_ID, DM.INSPECTION_EQ, TS.LOT_ID, TS.WAFER_ID, SM.X, SM.Y, DECODE(MAX (BN.HIGH_GEC), NULL , DECODE(MAX(SM.BIN), 1, 0, 1), 'N', 1, 0) AS BAD_DIE FROM TQP_WAFER_SUM TS, TQD_INSP_INFO DM, TQD_DEFECT_DIE SM, TQP_BINDESC BN WHERE 1 = 1 AND TS.WAFER_SEQ = SM.TEST_WAFER_SEQ AND DM.STEP_SEQ = SM.DM_STEP_SEQ AND TS.TESTED_DIE > 0 AND TS.PROBE_CNT = 0 AND DM.TEST = 1 AND TS.PROGRAM = BN.PROGRAM(+) AND SM.BIN = BN.BIN(+) GROUP BY TS.WAFER_SEQ, DM.STEP_SEQ, TS.END_TIME, TS.CUSTOMER, TS.DEVICE_ALIAS, TS.PRODUCT, TS.TESTAREA, TS.PROGRAM, TS.TESTER, TS.PROBE_CARD, DM.STEP_ID, DM.INSPECTION_EQ, TS.LOT_ID, TS.WAFER_ID, SM.X, SM.Y) SELECT DBH_DATE (A.TEST_TRAN_TIME, 'YYYY') AS YEAR, DBH_DATE (A.TEST_TRAN_TIME, 'MM') AS MONTH, DBH_DATE (A.TEST_TRAN_TIME, 'DD') AS DAY, DBH_DATE (A.TEST_TRAN_TIME, 'WW') AS WEEK, DBH_DATE (A.TEST_TRAN_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD') AS TRAN_DAY, A.WAFER_SEQ, A.STEP_SEQ, A.LOT_ID, A.WAFER_ID, A.TEST_TRAN_TIME, A.CUSTOMER, A.DEVICE_ALIAS, A.PRODUCT, A.TESTAREA, A.PROGRAM, A.TESTER, A.PROBE_CARD, A.STEP_ID, A.INSPECTION_EQ, MAX (B.TESTED_DIE) AS TESTED_DIE, COUNT (*) AS DEFECTIVE_DIE, SUM (A.BAD_DIE) AS BAD_DIE_CNT, ROUND (SUM (A.BAD_DIE) / COUNT (*) * 100, 2) AS KILL_RATIO, MAX (C.NETDIE) AS NETDIE, ROUND (MAX (B.TESTED_DIE) * (MAX (B.YIELD) / 100)) AS GOOD_CNT, MAX (B.TESTED_DIE) - ROUND (MAX (B.TESTED_DIE) * (MAX (B.YIELD) / 100)) AS BAD_CNT, ROUND ( ( ( MAX (B.TESTED_DIE) - ROUND (MAX (B.TESTED_DIE) * (MAX (B.YIELD) / 100))) / MAX (C.NETDIE)) * 100, 2) AS LOSS_YIELD FROM WT A, TQP_WAFER_SUM B, TQP_MAPDEF C WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.WAFER_SEQ = B.WAFER_SEQ AND A.DEVICE_ALIAS = C.MAPID AND A.WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq GROUP BY A.WAFER_SEQ, A.STEP_SEQ, A.LOT_ID, A.WAFER_ID, A.TEST_TRAN_TIME, A.CUSTOMER, A.DEVICE_ALIAS, A.PRODUCT, A.TESTAREA, A.PROGRAM, A.TESTER, A.PROBE_CARD, A.STEP_ID, A.INSPECTION_EQ
DELETE FROM TQC_MATCH_SUM WHERE 1 = 1 AND WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq
